## Tips & gotchas

- Use a scissor jack to push the spring out approximately 2 inches if using an extra jack. [t1046]

## Common mistakes

- Lifting both sides of the rear end simultaneously with one high-lift jack, which can restrict axle droop. [t1046]
- Failing to disconnect shocks before jacking up enough for shackle clearance. [t1046]
